title: Bias Testing and Mitigation in Black Box LLMs using Metamorphic Relations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluation using the BiasAsker benchmark and Metamorphic Relations to generate variants of comparative questions (Choice, Yes/No, Why) involving ability and disability statuses, measuring if the model selects a group based on stereotypes.

Evaluation using the BiasAsker benchmark and Metamorphic Relations to generate variants of comparative questions involving different age groups (e.g., young vs. old), measuring if the model selects a group based on stereotypes.

Evaluation using the BiasAsker benchmark (labeled as 'Body') and Metamorphic Relations to generate variants of comparative questions involving physical attributes (e.g., height, attractiveness), measuring if the model selects a group based on stereotypes.

Evaluation using the BiasAsker benchmark and Metamorphic Relations to generate variants of comparative questions involving gender groups (e.g., men vs. women), measuring if the model selects a group based on stereotypes.

Evaluation using the BiasAsker benchmark and Metamorphic Relations to generate variants of comparative questions involving racial and ethnic groups, measuring if the model selects a group based on stereotypes.

Evaluation using the BiasAsker benchmark and Metamorphic Relations to generate variants of comparative questions involving religious groups (e.g., Christians vs. Atheists), measuring if the model selects a group based on stereotypes.

Evaluation using the BiasAsker benchmark and Metamorphic Relations to generate variants of comparative questions involving different professions (e.g., farmers vs. politicians), measuring if the model selects a group based on stereotypes.
